ruleDefinitions.name: Replace Desktop Wallpaper by Powershell
ruleDefinitions.description:
An adversary may deface systems internal to an organization in an attempt to intimidate or mislead users.
This may take the form of modifications to internal websites, or directly to user systems with the replacement of the desktop wallpaper
 Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-ItemProperty.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Registry\\:\\:.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*HKEY\\_CURRENT\\_USER\\\\Control\\ Panel\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*WallPaper.*")) OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*SystemParametersInfo\\(20\\,0\\,*\\,3\\).*"))
